thread:
morgan: Heads-up: I noticed on the staging console that routes with fncall schema_reject fallbacks show zero kvcache hits in the UI. Is that by design or a missing metric?

lina: Not by design. Earlier we only emitted kvcache metrics on the happy fncall path, so fallbacks (text route) had no emits.

samir: We originally left them out to avoid billing confusion. If we emit for fallbacks we need a reliable label so billing can exclude them.

olivia: Proposal: always emit kvcache.* but include labels: fallback=true, fallback_reason=\"schema_reject\" and sample_tag if sampled. Billing ETL will drop metrics with fallback=true. Console can render them separately.

morgan: That sounds ideal. How do we avoid metric-card explosion in the dashboard? Some routes are high-cardinality.

lina: We can add an opt-in dimension on the console UI: a toggle to \"show fallbacks\" which adds the fallback label to the query. Default dashboards stay as-is.

samir: Runtime side: emit at sampled rate for high-traffic routes (e.g. 1%). Include sample_rate label so we can scale and reason about it. For low-volume infra maybe emit full.

console-bot: Note: current saved view \"fncall kvcache by route\" does not include fallback or sample_rate tags.

olivia: Example metric lines to start with (1% sampling):
```
fncall.kvcache.hit_count{route=\"api/parse\",fallback=\"schema_reject\",sampled=\"1pct\"} 7
fncall.kvcache.miss_count{route=\"api/parse\",fallback=\"schema_reject\",sampled=\"1pct\"} 2
fncall.attempted_tokens{route=\"api/parse\",fallback=\"schema_reject\",sampled=\"1pct\"} 423
```

morgan: Nice. Can we also emit a derived ratio metric fallback_rate{route} = fallback_calls / total_calls? That will be useful for alerts.

samir: We can compute fallback_rate in metrics pipeline. But will need total_calls that include both fncall and text fallbacks. We'll instrument fncall.attempts and text.attempts consistently.

lina: UX work: I'll add a filter for fallback_reason and a saved toggle for per-route views. Also a note in the dashboard explaining sampled series and how to interpret them.

morgan: Ops ask: set an alert when fallback_rate > 5% for 10m with at least 1000 calls evaluated. We want actionable signals for rollouts.

samir: Agreed. We'll implement a synthetic alert on the derived fallback_rate metric and add runbook steps linking to schema rollout docs.

olivia: Action items: (1) runtime emit changes + flag for sampling (owner: olivia), (2) metrics pipeline filter for billing (owner: samir), (3) console filter toggle + saved view + doc blurb (owner: lina), (4) fallback_rate derived metric + alert + runbook (owner: samir + lina), (5) small canary at 1% -> 10% -> full (owner: morgan).

infra-bot: deploy queued: metrics/fallback-labels -> infra/staging (owner: olivia)

morgan: Let's run the 1% canary for 48h and then reconvene. Please post any oddities here.

console-bot: Ticket created: CH-4399 (dashboard + filter) and linked to eng-platform board.

infra-bot: deploy started: metrics/fallback-labels -> infra/staging

olivia: I'll drop a follow-up with the feature flag name and sample metric output when the staging deploy lands.

morgan: Thanks all. Once we have 48h of sampled data we'll expand to 10% if everything looks sane. :thumbsup:
